fields.Name: Brave
fields.Description: Brave Search. Serves from its own 30B+ page index rather than reselling Google's or Bing's, so it fails independently of every other provider here. Returns title/url/snippet, and measured lowest latency of the providers in this set. Default primary.

fields.Name: Tavily
fields.Description: Tavily. Results arrive as extracted page content rather than snippets plus links, which saves an agent a second round trip per result. Can also return a synthesized answer. An aggregator rather than an index of its own.

fields.Name: Perplexity
fields.Description: Perplexity. Hits come from the raw /search endpoint (flat per-query price, sub-second); the Sonar chat models are used only when a synthesized answer is explicitly requested.

fields.Name: Google Custom Search
fields.Description: Google Custom Search JSON API. CLOSED TO NEW CUSTOMERS and DISCONTINUED ON 2027-01-01 — present so hosts holding an existing key keep working through the transition. Remove this row once the key stops working.

fields.Name: DuckDuckGo
fields.Description: DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API. Needs no credential, so a host that has configured nothing still gets some capability — but it returns disambiguation topics rather than a ranked result set, so coverage is thin. Last resort; treat reliance on it as unconfigured.
